context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 tested the AI Outreach Drafter feature. The AI Draft button is visible ONLY for admin users on pipeline cards (between Info and Update Status buttons). Button has data-testid='ai-draft-btn-{channel_id}'. Clicking it opens a slide-down panel (data-testid='ai-draft-panel-{channel_id}') with: business email with copy icon, SUBJECT label with text, MESSAGE label with body, Copy All button (data-testid='ai-draft-copy-all-{channel_id}'), Regenerate button (data-testid='ai-draft-regenerate-{channel_id}'), and collapse button (chevron up).
